faqs.question: What is the best WhatsApp CRM for a small business?
faqs.answer: The best fit depends on the work the team needs to complete. A small business should normally prioritize a shared inbox, clear ownership, contact history, simple automation, approved-template broadcasts, transparent limits, and a price model it can forecast. Test those workflows with real users instead of choosing from a feature count alone.

faqs.question: Is a WhatsApp CRM different from the WhatsApp Business app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The WhatsApp Business app is useful for a small operation on a limited number of devices. A WhatsApp CRM typically adds team assignment, contact records, permissions, automation, reporting, pipeline or lifecycle tracking, and controlled use of the WhatsApp Business Platform.

faqs.question: Does CRM subscription pricing include Meta messaging charges?
faqs.answer: Often it does not. Many providers separate the software subscription from WhatsApp Business Platform messaging charges, and some also charge for active contacts, users, hosted numbers, automation, AI, onboarding, or add-ons. Confirm every cost component in writing.

faqs.question: Should I choose a WhatsApp-first CRM or an omnichannel platform?
faqs.answer: Choose a WhatsApp-first CRM when WhatsApp is the main operating channel and you want focused setup and workflows. Choose an omnichannel platform when email, voice, web chat, Instagram, and other channels must share one queue and reporting model. The right choice follows your channel mix, not a universal ranking.

faqs.question: What should I test during a WhatsApp CRM trial?
faqs.answer: Import sample contacts, assign real conversations, verify contact history, move a lead through the pipeline, run a test campaign to opted-in recipients, build one automation with an exception path, test human handoff, verify permissions, export a report, and document how data can be exported.

faqs.question: Can a WhatsApp CRM send broadcast messages?
faqs.answer: Many can, but the workflow and limits vary. Check template approval visibility, consent records, audience segmentation, exclusions, scheduling, queue behavior, failure reporting, replies, and any software or Meta messaging charges.

faqs.question: How do I avoid choosing the wrong WhatsApp CRM?
faqs.answer: Write weighted requirements before demos, compare the same real workflows in every platform, include frontline users in testing, calculate total cost rather than headline price, review permissions and data portability, and record evidence for every decision.

faqs.question: Is TalkWagon the best choice for every company?
faqs.answer: No platform is the best choice for every company. TalkWagon is designed for teams that want a WhatsApp-focused CRM with a shared inbox, contact and pipeline context, broadcasts, automations, flows, permissions, and an AI knowledge workflow. Teams that require a different channel mix or specialist commerce stack should compare those needs directly.
